stories.title: Tensions emerge at first Kelowna council meeting over board appointments
stories.summary: The regional district board is the only one of more than a dozen for which councillors receive compensation.

stories.title: Crown seeks dangerous offender status for convicted Vancouver sex offender
stories.summary: Gordon James Joseph Leclerc, 75, was originally charged with aggravated sexual assault and sexual assault with a weapon – a cane – between Sept. 7 and Sept. 9, 2021.

stories.title: Fatal B.C. attack involved 4 bears displaying ‘predatory behaviour,’ officials say
stories.summary: A GoFundMe page identified the victims as Jenny Balcarras and her daughter, Selah Reed. One person’s remains were found in the Snooka West Trail area last Monday.

stories.title: B.C. deluge could bring 250 mm of rain as search for missing canoeist suspended
stories.summary: A deluge hitting Vancouver Island and other parts of southwest B.C. could bring more than 250 millimetres of rain in some places, as forecasters warn of floods and landslides.

stories.title: Frustration level high for beleaguered Canucks
stories.summary: Manny Malhotra knew this wouldn't be any easy season.

stories.title: Flyers outlast Canucks for 3-1 victory
stories.summary: The Philadelphia Flyers withstood a late rally to down the struggling Vancouver Canucks 3-1 on Monday.

stories.title: B.C. MP’s misfiled dinner expense raises questions about oversight
stories.summary: The expense was approved in 2024 and was not questioned until independent journalist Isaac Peltz posted about it on Instagram recently.

stories.title: New Kelowna ‘Home for Belonging’ gives neurodivergent community a permanent place to connect
stories.summary: A home in Kelowna is giving neurodivergent people and their caregivers a permanent place to build community, make friends and take part in programs centred around their interests

stories.title: Kelowna mayor takes seat on Rutland business association
stories.summary: Among the appointments, Mayor Tom Dyas has named council newcomer and downtown business owner Brady Rogers to the Downtown Kelowna Association board.

stories.title: Orange-level rainfall warnings issued as 3rd storm heads for B.C. Coast
stories.summary: The third in a series of storms is heading for B.C., after wild weather knocked out power to thousands, triggered evacuations and left one person dead over the weekend.
